confidence_notes: Beer assumes a schooner. The [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Newcastle) sample is small; [Drink Map](https://drinkmap.net/newcastle/drink-prices) prices postdate July and its wine figures reflect the cheapest glasses. Cocktail and wine estimates also reflect their local relationship to beer. Accommodation is a less certain general-knowledge estimate, especially for hostels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Coastal New South Wales provides the regional basis, with Sydney as a higher-cost reference and allowance for Newcastle's smaller visitor market and winter season.
